invalidated_by.detail: The 09:31 execute decision used the recovery_action determined after observing the 10:30 bar. Counterfactual replay changed the open action when only that future flag changed.
Training segments were split only by signal_date although the execute/hold label needs the exit open and the next target reset cost.
Annual wealth floor filtered variant/year but omitted the development segment, allowing reused outer results to influence a development gate.
Equity deducted fees but the next pretrade weights came from gross marked values. Fee-corrected settlement now debits cash at each event and normalizes by net NAV; stress reprices the fixed events.

repairs: The 09:31 route no longer consumes recovery_action; 10:31 recovery is evaluated after the open holdings are fixed.
Each label records max(exit_date at 09:30 ET, next target trade_date at 09:31 ET); training admits it only strictly before the actual first test execution.
The annual wealth floor now includes only development_walk_forward rows, with a counterexample test.
Shared cash-fee accounting drives baseline, teacher labels, HOLD validation, and fixed-event cost stress.
authorized_next_action: Retrain the fixed original allocation candidate under a new recorder identity, then validate the repaired fixed HOLD router in a new card with unchanged gates. Do not treat it as the lost original model.
